The '''Portable Environmental Support Unit''' was a type of [[Breath mask/Legends|breath mask]] manufactured by [[Bavar Breathing Systems]]. Bulkier than regular models, they included reusable [[oxygen tank]]s that held compressed [[Oxygen/Legends|oxygen]]. The mask covered the face and nose of [[Humanoid/Legends|humanoids]].<ref name="J15" />
